note: MC-13 (brief 059, Motive M059-5.3; Keel's P59-LOUD-YARD), the service drive's loud-wait twin: route-b-board to the pickup, but the Fixer shoots the pickup camera out as Vale's car parks (gunfire: Alert 2), and the Scout and Fixer get into the car the Tech drove round. The Enforcer takes Vale from the back seat, carries him 3.5 m and boards, and Go is refused: the car is held (the official entrance's officers, the nearest entry to the stand, §07 loud: their blocker on the lane). Nobody of the cell fights, so the car can't leave, and the player withdraws (the free abort). Left to wait, the run seals (9:47.7 under the rulebook's final intent, agent) or, under the control intent every, the police shoot the cell down in the car: the Withdraw keeps the twin to what MC-13 reads, the refusal.
